name: Stock Balance
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item AS "Item:Link/Item:120",
    sle.warehouse AS "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:150",
    SUM(sle.qty) AS "Balance Qty:Float:120",
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty * rate) / NULLIF(SUM(qty), 0), 0) 
     FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` 
     WHERE item = sle.item AND qty > 0 AND docstatus = 1) AS "Valuation Rate:Currency:120",
    SUM(sle.qty) * (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty * rate) / NULLIF(SUM(qty), 0), 0) 
                    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` 
                    WHERE item = sle.item AND qty > 0 AND docstatus = 1) AS "Balance Value:Currency:120"
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
WHERE sle.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY sle.item, sle.warehouse
